hosting.storage: Ephemeral: demo data resets on restart or spin-down.

humanInputs: The browser harness submits explicit synthetic-owner confirmation and approval through the real UI. The model learns and plans against real FalkorDB; the Workspace Lab independently verifies persisted resources.

requests.reason: Approval authority changed; resume to prepare a fresh plan

data.name: Q3_current_role_holder
data.query:
MATCH (person:Person)-[assignment:HOLDS_ROLE]->(role:Role {id: $roleId})
    WHERE assignment.validFrom <= $now AND (assignment.validTo IS NULL OR assignment.validTo > $now)
    RETURN person.json AS personJson, assignment.json AS assignmentJson,
      assignment.revision AS assignmentRevision, assignment.validFrom AS validFrom, assignment.validTo AS validTo,
      person.id AS personId, role.id AS roleId
